}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610 MP4'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T; :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 64GB (up to 128MB) (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF Card (max.256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 8GB (up to 32MB) (LPDDR4x) RAM *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 1x USB 3.0 (USB 3.1 Gen 1), :1x USB (Type-C) 3.1 (DP1.4/OTG) ports *mPCIe: 1x M.2 2280 (Key M) slot for :1x NVMe SSD (PCIe 3.0 4-lanes) *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43752 (SDIO 3.0) • [[SparkLAN]] :802.11abgn/ac/ax (2T2R), Bluetooth 5.0 (BLE) *Network: 2x 2.5GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: USB (Type-C) PD 2.0 :9V/2A, 12V/2A, 15V/2A
